note: Per-lane collected-test budget (scripts/check_test_budget.py). A lane over budget fails check-preflight: condense tests in the same PR, or run `uv run python scripts/check_test_budget.py --update-baseline` and state the net test delta (Tests: +added ~extended -removed) and why in the PR body. Budgets are current count + 5% at the last update; never raise them silently.
